question: **The main theme of the passage is: **

options.text: natural soaps for skin care in ancient times
kinds of ingredients in soap making

solution:
The correct answer is: **natural soaps for skin care in ancient times**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Theme** means the subject of a talk, a piece of writing or a work of art.
 
• If we read the given passage carefully we come to know that the passage is all about how soaps were made in the ancient period, which ingredients were used at that time to make soap and how ancient people used natural things to produce soap which they could use for their hair and skincare.
 
• Therefore, we can easily say that the main theme of the passage is natural soaps for skin care in ancient times.

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
